$comment: Justified exceptions for scripts/audit-design-system.mjs. `file` is a glob relative to the repo root, `rule` is a rule id or `*`, optional `match` is a regex tested against the snippet or the whole line. Every entry needs a `reason`.

entries.reason: Dev-only fixtures; never shipped.
Third-party brand marks inside link embeds: the YouTube red play button and the Instagram verified badge.
Art panel (the auth media surface, 6.5): gradients are built from inks read off the active theme at runtime, with alpha stops.
Generated Phosphor path data.
Mask rect/stroke inside the SVG mask must be literal #fff/#000; not a theme colour.
Warning tint mixed from a token; a --rm-warning-tint token would retire this.
Search <mark> highlight inside running text; below the radius scale on purpose.
Spinner loop, not UI motion.
Theme swatches render the theme's own palette, not the active theme (7.1).
Theme preview renders the previewed theme's own palette, not the active theme (7.1).
rm-loading-exit runs 1.2s: a loader dissolving into the app, not UI motion (10.1).
Marketing page has its own responsive ladder (decision 8); not the app shell.
Dev-only debug tool, not shipped UI (decision 8).
Scaled collectible mockups size every part in container units (cqw) so the preview keeps its proportions at any tile size; a fixed radius token would not scale with it.
Theme swatch miniature: the 3px radius and hairline heights are the shrunken app chrome inside a ~120px swatch, not UI at real size (same reason as its raw-color entry).
Theme swatch miniature: minimum heights for the shrunken message lines and composer so they stay visible at small swatch sizes.
CSS mask-image alpha stops for the nameplate fade: black here is mask opacity, not a colour on screen.
Dithered art surface (6.5, like AuthArtPanel): colours are inks read off the active theme at runtime and given alpha for the fallback gradient.
Avatar initials scale with the avatar box (18/20/24/32/40/80). No text-ui step fits 8-10px or 30px, so each size step carries its own glyph size (talk-tree-spec avatar sizes).
The 18px avatar is the tree occupant size (talk-tree-spec, tree occupant row).
Switch geometry from the spec: 30x18 track, 14px thumb travel (talk-tree-spec, Switch).
